decisive_spans.text: Grossly, the mass was well‐circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray‐white, and measured 25 × 15 × 20 mm.

response.rationale: The vignette describes a mass that is 'well-circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray-white'. This description directly supports Fibroma (D2) and contradicts Neurofibroma (D1). While Leiomyoma (D3) is also supported by some features, the specific description of 'gray-white' and 'well-circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin' aligns more strongly with Fibroma.
